notes.title: Just A Demo - Free Demo Release
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40284516/d61ecfb2c45d9ec51b988449449d0a27130f2793.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]JUST A GUY demo will be available on September 12, 2025![/b][/p][p]Just A Guy (JAG) free Demo will be available tomorrow at 14:00 (GMT +2) on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]I've put a lot of work and love into this game, and I'm really looking forward to seeing players from around the world try out the demo and give their feedback.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="QlKFgsbpG_8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]DEMO FEATURES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Online multiplayer mode for 2 players (solo mode possible).[/p][/*][*][p]1 large level to explore, filled with activities and secrets to discover.[/p][/*][*][p]Try out different vehicles such as cars, planes, helicopters, boats, jet skis, and much more.[/p][/*][*][p]Experience a wide range of gameplay abilities such as speed shoes, boxing gloves, balloons, grabbing, climbing, driving, falling, sliding and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Estimated time to complete the demo: 2 to 6 hours.[/p][/*][*][p]Attention - GAMEPAD only for now.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the demo![/p][p]Thanks.[/p][p]David.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
